title: Call During the Journey
statementMd:
You live in a city consisting of n intersections and m streets connecting some pairs of intersections. You can travel in either direction on each street. No two streets connect the same pair of intersections, and no street connects an intersection to itself. You can reach any intersection from any other, possibly passing through some other intersections.

Every minute, you can board a bus at intersection ui and travel for li1 minutes to intersection vi. Conversely, you can travel from intersection vi to intersection ui in li1 minutes. You can only board and exit the bus at intersections. You can only board the bus at an intersection if you are currently there.

You can also walk along each street, which takes li2>li1 minutes.

You can make stops at intersections.

You live at intersection number 1. Today you woke up at time 0, and you have an important event scheduled at intersection number n, which you must reach no later than time t0. You also have a phone call planned that will last from t1 to t2 minutes (t1<t2<t0).

During the phone call, you cannot ride the bus, but you can walk along any streets, make stops, or stay at home. You can exit the bus at minute t1 and board the bus again at minute t2.

Since you want to get enough sleep, you became curious — how late can you leave home to have time to talk on the phone and still not be late for the event?

## Input

The first line contains an integer t (1≤t≤104) — the number of test cases. The following are the descriptions of the test cases.

The first line of each test case contains two integers n, m (2≤n≤105,1≤m≤105) — the number of intersections and streets in the city.

The second line of each test case contains three integers t0, t1, t2 (1≤t1<t2<t0≤109) — the start time of the event, the start time of the phone call, and its end time, respectively.

The next m lines of each test case contain descriptions of the streets.

The i-th line contains four integers ui, vi, li1, li2 (1≤ui,vi≤n, ui≠vi, 1≤li1<li2≤109) — the numbers of the intersections connected by the i-th street, as well as the travel time along the street by bus and on foot. It is guaranteed that no two streets connect the same pair of intersections and that it is possible to reach any intersection from any other.

It is guaranteed that the sum of the values of n across all test cases does not exceed 105. It is also guaranteed that the sum of the values of m across all test cases does not exceed 105.

## Output

For each test case, output a single integer — the latest time you can leave home to have time to talk on the phone and not be late for the event. If you cannot reach the event on time, output `-1`.
statementZhMd:
你居住在一座城市中，这座城市由 $n$ 个路口和连接其中一些路口的 $m$ 条街道组成。每条街道都可以双向通行。不存在连接同一对路口的两条街道，也不存在连接同一路口自身的街道。你可以从任意一个路口到达任意其他路口，途中可能经过一些其他路口。

每分钟，你都可以在路口 $u_i$ 乘坐公交车，并经过 $l_{i1}$ 分钟到达路口 $v_i$。反过来，你也可以经过 $l_{i1}$ 分钟从路口 $v_i$ 到达路口 $u_i$。你只能在路口乘坐或下车，并且只有当你当前位于某个路口时，才能在该路口乘坐公交车。

你也可以沿每条街道步行，但步行所需时间为 $l_{i2}>l_{i1}$。

你可以在路口停留。

你住在编号为 1 的路口。今天你在时间 0 醒来，并且在编号为 $n$ 的路口有一场重要活动，你必须不晚于时间 $t_0$ 到达那里。此外，你还安排了一通电话，通话时间为从第 $t_1$ 分钟到第 $t_2$ 分钟（$t_1<t_2<t_0$）。

通话期间，你不能乘坐公交车，但可以沿任意街道步行、在路口停留，或待在家中。你可以在第 $t_1$ 分钟下公交车，并在第 $t_2$ 分钟再次乘坐公交车。

为了获得充足的睡眠，你想知道：为了有时间通电话并且不耽误活动，你最晚可以在什么时间离开家？

## 题目描述

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $t$（$1≤t≤10^4$）——测试用例的数量。接下来是各测试用例的描述。

每个测试用例的第一行包含两个整数 $n,m$（$2≤n≤10^5,1≤m≤10^5$）——城市中的路口数量和街道数量。

每个测试用例的第二行包含三个整数 $t_0,t_1,t_2$（$1≤t_1<t_2<t_0≤10^9$）——活动开始时间、电话开始时间和电话结束时间。

接下来的 $m$ 行描述街道。

每个测试用例的第 $i$ 行包含四个整数 $u_i,v_i,l_{i1},l_{i2}$（$1≤u_i,v_i≤n, u_i≠v_i, 1≤l_{i1}<l_{i2}≤10^9$）——由该街道连接的两个路口编号，以及乘坐公交车和步行通过该街道所需的时间。

保证不存在两条街道连接同一对路口，并且从任意路口都可以到达任意其他路口。

保证所有测试用例的 $n$ 之和不超过 $10^5$。

保证所有测试用例的 $m$ 之和不超过 $10^5$。

## 输出格式

对于每个测试用例，输出一个整数——为了有时间通电话且不耽误活动，你最晚可以离开家的时间。如果无法按时到达活动地点，输出 `-1`。
